    • CANCELLATION POLICY
Cancellation by Customer
    • For almost of our tours, once tour is confirmed and fully paid but for one reason they cancel the tour, the following charges will apply in the event of cancellation prior to tour commencement:
More than 21 days before arrival: No charge
    • 14-21 days before arrival: 20% of total tour price
    • 7-14 days before arrival: 45% of total tour price
    • 3-7 days before arrival: 75% of total tour price
    • Within 3 days before arrival: 100% tour price
Notes:
    • There will be no refund given for any unused or missed ground arrangements, sightseeing, meals or hotel accommodations.
    • Cancellation is calculated for working days, excluding Saturday, Sunday and Holidays and depends on cut off date of included services.
    • Non-refundable if you skip the tour halfway through
    • Cancellation by Weather
    • In case of an unexpected situation/ bad weather causes an effect on your trip after commencement, we serve the right to change the itinerary of your booked tour for the safety of all clients in the group. If there are more than one solution, we will ask for your permission and agreement to do the next step. However, each party is responsible for trying its best to help minimize losses caused by force majeure.
